children.doc: /** 🚦️ Tool run lifecycle: the pure transition table, events, effects, admission and the `ToolRunMachine` reducer. TypeScript twin of `🚦️lifecycle/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 📊️ Tool run progress: verdicts, the step vocabulary, the bounded step ring and the progress counters. TypeScript twin of `🧮️step-progress/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 🗄️ Tool run trace: columnar trace pages, deltas, cursors and the resident `ToolRunTraceStore`. TypeScript twin of `🗄️trace-store/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 🎞️ Tool run tick: the value one tick of a run carries (progress, steps, trace pages, appended entities and an opaque payload). */
/** 🔤️ Tool run pack wire codec: pack values, the bounded buffer and reader, and the trace page, trace delta and tick encoders and decoders. TypeScript twin of `🔤️codec/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 🧾️ Tool run JSON wire: the lossless JSON forms (u64 as decimal text, bytes as hex) of identities, steps, progress, trace and ticks. */
/** 🪧️ Tool run panel: the key scheme of the framework ToolRun panel and the diff of the runs a rendered panel holds. */
/** 🏷️ Tool run actions and labels: the framework-reserved action ids, chords, descriptors, legality and the EN/DE panel text. TypeScript twin of `🏷️actions-labels/🦀️.rs`. */
